   41 def policy() -> dict:
   42     p = data.read_json(POLICY)
   43     if (p["methods"] != ["G_half"] or p["domains"] != "AB" or p["main_rng_order"] != "ABC"
   44             or p["physical_updates"] != 576 or p["gradient_group_presentations"] != 864
   45             or p["physical_stage_states"] != 2 or p["epoch_diagnostic_points"] != 12
   46             or p["history_supervision"] != .1 or p["teacher_weight"] != .5 or p["seed"] != "s0"

   50                 primary_role="raw", success="B_end_H_minus_S_each_AB_MAP_CI_lower_strictly_positive")
   51             or p["cpu_verification"]["maximum_seconds"] != 180
   52             or p["native_verification"]["maximum_seconds"] != 600
   53             or p["native_verification"]["actual_updates"] != 6
  177 def train_stage(model, optimizer, current, memory, valid, c, arm, stage, root, budget, *, entry=None):
  178     entry = entry or sys.modules[__name__]
  179     if parent.adam_step(optimizer) != (stage-1)*288:
  180         raise ValueError("Stage continuity differs")
  181     if memory is not None:
  182         memory.begin_stage(stage)
  183     before = None if memory is None else memory.summary()
  184     schedule, _ = parent.schedule(current, parent.contract(), entry.method.RNG_ORDER, stage)
  185     name = "AB"[stage-1]+"_"+arm
  186     budget.phase = name
  187     rows, captures = [], []
  188     for step, group in enumerate(schedule, 1):
  189         history, target = (None, None) if memory is None else memory.draw()
  190         row = entry.method.update(model, optimizer, group, history, target, c, arm, stage, step, budget.check)
  191         if parent.adam_step(optimizer) != (stage-1)*288+step:
  192             raise ValueError("Actual optimizer call missing")
  193         rows.append({**row, "step": step, "current_uid": group.uid, "history_uid": history.uid if history else None})
  194         if step % 48 == 0:
  195             captures.append(entry.method.capture(model, optimizer, current, memory, valid, c, arm,
  196                 stage, step//48, root/"diagnostics", name, budget.check))
  197         if step == 1 or step % 24 == 0:
  198             print(data.json_bytes({"event": "updates", "point": name, "completed": step, **budget.snapshot()}).decode(), flush=True)
  199     after = None if memory is None else memory.summary()
  200     if before is not None and any(before[k] != after[k] for k in ("members", "seen", "origins", "tables")):
  201         raise ValueError("History targets/membership changed within B")
  202     path = root/"updates"/(name+".json")
  203     data.write_json(path, {"arm": arm, "stage": stage, "updates": 288, "adam_step": parent.adam_step(optimizer),
  204         "current_ids": [g.uid for g in schedule], "history_ids": [r["history_uid"] for r in rows if r["history_uid"]],
  205         "memory_before": before, "memory_after": after, "rows": rows})
  206     return data.record(path, root), captures
  207 
  208 
  209 def memory_from(payload: bytes, arm: str, *, entry=None):
  210     entry = entry or sys.modules[__name__]
  211     if arm not in entry.method.ARMS:
  212         raise ValueError("Unknown arm Memory")
  213     memory = record.Memory.from_bytes(payload)
  214     if any(memory.maps.get(k) != v for k, v in entry.method.metadata(arm).items()):
  215         raise ValueError("Memory candidate identity differs")
  216     return memory
  217 
  218 
  219 def continuity(model, optimizer, memory):
  220     return {"model": core.state_digest(model.state_dict()), "adam": core.state_digest(optimizer.state_dict()),
  221             "rng": diag.rng_state(), "modes": [m.training for m in model.modules()],
  222             "memory_sha256": hashlib.sha256(memory.to_bytes()).hexdigest()}
  223 
  224 
  225 def restore_point(path, expected, model, optimizer, arm, *, entry=None):
  226     entry = entry or sys.modules[__name__]
  227     meta = core.restore_state(path, model, optimizer, expected["state_sha256"])
  228     if entry.method.bind(model, meta) != arm:
  229         raise ValueError("Restored arm differs")
  230     for m, mode in zip(model.modules(), meta["modes"], strict=True):
  231         m.training = mode
  232     diag.restore_rng(meta["rng"])
  233     return meta
  234

  236 def checkpoint(root, name, model, optimizer, memory, current, calibration, valid, c, arm, stage, budget, *, entry=None):
  237     entry = entry or sys.modules[__name__]
  238     if len(calibration) != 12 or len(valid) != 40 or parent.adam_step(optimizer) != 288*stage:
  239         raise ValueError("Endpoint scope differs")
  319         raise ValueError("H partition differs from frozen S/G")
  320     data.write_json(root/"partition.json", split)
  321     manifest = {"status": "RUNNING", "source_files": entry.sources(), "public_inputs": checked, "pretrained_archive": archive,
  322         "partition": data.record(root/"partition.json", root), "points": {}, "training": {}, "diagnostics": {},
  323         "baseline_identity": data.record(entry.BASELINE, data.ROOT), "initials": {}, "starts": {}, "physical_updates": 0, "gradient_group_presentations": 0}
  324     data.write_json(root/"startup.json", manifest)
  325     groups["train"] = previous.parse_once(job, groups["train"], c, "train",
  326         loader=lambda gs, cfg, s: entry.attach_labels(gs, cfg, s, metadata))
  327     selected, after = entry.partition(groups, metadata, c)
  328     if after != split:
  329         raise ValueError("Labels changed partition")
  330     def domain(role, d):
  331         return [g for g,r in zip(selected[role], split[role], strict=True) if r["domain"] == d]
  332     valid = groups["development"]
  333     for arm in entry.method.ARMS:
  334         c["pooling_stats"] = {}
  335         model, optimizer, initial = entry.fresh(c)
  336         entry.method.bind(model, entry.method.metadata(arm))
  337         manifest["initials"][arm] = initial
  338         if initial != baseline["initial_identity"] or parent.adam_step(optimizer) != 0:
  339             raise ValueError("Independent identical untrained starts required")
  340         memory = None
  341         for stage, d in enumerate("AB", 1):
  342             name = d+"_"+arm
  343             if stage == 2:
  344                 manifest["starts"][arm] = continuity(model, optimizer, memory)
  345                 if manifest["starts"][arm] != manifest["points"]["A_"+arm]["continuity"]:
  346                     raise ValueError("B did not continue its own restored A state")
  347             current = domain("fit", d)
  348             log, captures = entry.train_stage(model, optimizer, current, memory, valid, c, arm, stage, root, budget)
  349             endpoint, memory = entry.checkpoint(root, name, model, optimizer, memory, current if stage==1 else None,
  350                 domain("calibration", d), valid, c, arm, stage, budget)
  351             manifest["training"][name], manifest["diagnostics"][name], manifest["points"][name] = log, captures, endpoint
  352             manifest["physical_updates"] += 288
  353             manifest["gradient_group_presentations"] += 288*stage
  354             data.write_json(root/"progress.json", manifest)
  355         del model, optimizer, memory
  356         gc.collect()
  357         if torch.cuda.is_initialized():
  358             torch.cuda.empty_cache()
  359     manifest["status"] = entry.COMPLETE
  360     data.write_json(root/"manifest.json", manifest)
  361     for source in manifest["source_files"]:
  362         destination = root/"sources"/source["path"]
  363         destination.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
  364         shutil.copyfile(data.verify(data.ROOT/source["path"], source), destination)
  365     return manifest, split, valid, metadata

   80     for q in range(28):
   81         ids = [(j, LOOKUP[tuple(sorted((q,j)))]) for j in range(28) if j != q]
   82         pos = [k for j,k in ids if group.labels[k]]

   88 def independent_objective(table, group, seed, arm, target=None):
   89     a0, a1 = record.assignment(group), record.assignment(group, seed)
   90     v0, v1 = [independent_pool(table, slots, arm) for slots in (a0,a1)]
   91     supervised = (independent_loss(v0, group)+independent_loss(v1, group))/2
   92     return supervised if target is None else .1*supervised+.5*(v0-independent_pool(torch.as_tensor(target,device=table.device,dtype=table.dtype),a0,arm)).square().mean()

   95 def shared_memory(arm):
   96     groups = [handmade_group(f"A_fit_{i:02}") for i in range(48)]
   97     memory = record.Memory("ABC")
   98     memory.retain(groups, 1, lambda g: (np.sin(np.arange(1540)/7)*2).astype(np.float32))
   99     memory.maps.update(method.metadata(arm))
  100     return memory

  103 def verify_native_table(table, group, seed, reference, arm):
  104     """Actual FP32 table -> both views -> independent rank values/gradients."""
  105     rows = []
  106     for name, slots in (("A0",record.assignment(group)),("A1",record.assignment(group,seed))):
  107         scores = method.account_logits(table,slots,arm).detach().requires_grad_(True)
  108         rank = method.objectives(scores,torch.as_tensor(group.labels,device=scores.device,dtype=scores.dtype))["rank_pos"]
  109         gradient, = torch.autograd.grad(rank,scores)
  110         value, grad, _ = analytic_rank(scores.detach().double().cpu().tolist(),group.labels)
  111         np.testing.assert_allclose(float(rank.detach()),value,atol=ATOL,rtol=RTOL)
  112         np.testing.assert_allclose(gradient.detach().cpu().numpy(),grad,atol=ATOL,rtol=RTOL)
  113         rows.append(dict(view=name,value=float(rank.detach()),reference=value,gradient_max_error=float(np.max(np.abs(gradient.detach().cpu().numpy()-grad)))))
  114     return dict(arm=arm,uid=group.uid,role="history" if reference is not None else "current",views=rows)

   20 def policy() -> dict:
   21     p = data.read_json(POLICY)
   22     if (p["methods"] != ["C", "S"] or p["orders"] != list(parent.ORDERS)
   23             or p["physical_updates"] != 4320 or p["gradient_group_presentations"] != 7776
   24             or p["pair_chunk"] != 512 or p["record_dimension"] != 2048

   27         raise ValueError("Record replay contract differs")
   28     return p

  185 def update(model: Any, optimizer: Any, current: data.Group, history: data.Group | None,
  186            reference: np.ndarray | None, c: dict, arm: str, order: str, stage: int,
  187            step: int, check: Callable = lambda: None, observe: Callable | None = None,
  188            objective_fn: Callable | None = None) -> dict:
  189     import torch
  190     model.train()
  191     optimizer.zero_grad(set_to_none=True)
  192     optimizer.param_groups[0]["lr"] = parent.stage_lr(step)
  193     optimizer.param_groups[1]["lr"] = .001
  194     logs = {}
  195     for role, group, target in (("current", current, None), ("history", history, reference)):
  196         if group is None:
  197             continue
  198         logs[role] = backward_group(model, group, c, arm,
  199             data.seed_for(20260918, order, stage, step, role, "dropout"),
  200             data.seed_for(20260918, order, stage, step, role, group.uid, "regroup"), target, check,
  201             objective_fn=objective_fn)
  202         if observe is not None:
  203             observe(role, logs[role])
  204     norm = torch.nn.utils.clip_grad_norm_(model.parameters(), 1., error_if_nonfinite=True)
  205     check()
  206     optimizer.step()
  207     return {**logs, "gradient_norm": float(norm), "encoder_lr": parent.stage_lr(step),
  208             "head_lr": .001, "total": sum(v["weighted"] for v in logs.values())}
  209 
  210 
  211 def reference(model: Any, group: data.Group, c: dict, check: Callable = lambda: None) -> np.ndarray:
  212     import torch
  213     model.eval()
  214     with torch.inference_mode():
  215         table = pair_table(model, record_vectors(model, group, c, check), check)
  216     result = table.float().cpu().numpy().copy()
  217     if not np.isfinite(result).all():
  218         raise ValueError("Nonfinite source table")
  219     return result
  220 
  221 
  222 def score(model: Any, groups: list[data.Group], c: dict, check: Callable = lambda: None) -> np.ndarray:
  223     import torch
  224     model.eval()
  225     with torch.inference_mode():
  226         rows = [account_logits(pair_table(model, record_vectors(model, g, c, check), check),
  227                                assignment(g)).float().cpu().numpy() for g in groups]
  228     result = np.stack(rows).astype(np.float32)
  229     if result.shape != (len(groups), 378) or not np.isfinite(result).all():
  230         raise ValueError("Incomplete blind scores")
  231     return result

   67     torch.set_rng_state(torch.tensor(state["cpu"], dtype=torch.uint8))

   69         if len(state["cuda"]) != torch.cuda.device_count():
   70             raise ValueError("CUDA RNG count differs")
   71         torch.cuda.set_rng_state_all([torch.tensor(row, dtype=torch.uint8) for row in state["cuda"]])

   32 def make_optimizer(model: Any, config: dict) -> Any:
   33     import torch
   34     p = config["optimizer"]
   35     return torch.optim.AdamW(
   36         [{"params": model.encoder.parameters(), "lr": p["encoder_lr"],
   37           "weight_decay": p["encoder_weight_decay"]},
   38          {"params": model.head.parameters(), "lr": p["head_lr"],
   39           "weight_decay": p["head_weight_decay"]}],
   40         betas=tuple(p["betas"]), eps=p["eps"], foreach=p["foreach"])

   43 def model_files(config: dict) -> dict:
   44     base = data.ROOT / config["model"]["path"]
   45     rows = [{"path": path.relative_to(base).as_posix(), "size_bytes": path.stat().st_size,
   46              "sha256": data.sha256(path)}
   47             for path in sorted(base.rglob("*"), key=lambda p: p.relative_to(base).as_posix())
   48             if path.is_file() and ".cache" not in path.parts and "__pycache__" not in path.parts
   49             and path.suffix != ".pyc"]
   50     # Preserve step7's canonical_hash: size_bytes keys and no trailing newline.
   51     content = hashlib.sha256(data.json_bytes(rows).rstrip(b"\n")).hexdigest()
   52     return {"files": rows, "file_count": len(rows),
   53             "total_size_bytes": sum(row["size_bytes"] for row in rows), "content_sha256": content}

   56 def load_model(config: dict, device: str = "cuda:0") -> Any:
   57     import torch
   58     from sentence_transformers import SentenceTransformer
   59 
   60     torch.manual_seed(config["initialization_seed"])
   61     encoder = SentenceTransformer(str(data.ROOT / config["model"]["path"]),
   62                                   device=device, local_files_only=True)
   63     encoder.default_prompt_name = None
   64     encoder.max_seq_length = config["model"]["token_budget"]
   65     if encoder.get_sentence_embedding_dimension() != config["model"]["embedding_dim"]:
   66         raise ValueError("LaBSE embedding dimension differs")
   67     if config["model"]["activation_checkpointing"]:
   68         encoder[0].auto_model.gradient_checkpointing_enable(
   69             gradient_checkpointing_kwargs={"use_reentrant": False, "preserve_rng_state": True})
   70     # Head initialization must not depend on encoder loader's incidental RNG use.
   71     torch.manual_seed(config["initialization_seed"])
   72     return build_model(encoder, config["model"]["embedding_dim"], config["model"]["pair_head"][1]).to(device)
  157 def state_digest(value: Any) -> str:
  158     """All tensors, scalar state and optimizer parameter groups, without aliases."""
  159     import torch
  160     digest = hashlib.sha256()
  161 
  162     def visit(item: Any) -> None:
  163         if isinstance(item, torch.Tensor):
  164             tensor = item.detach().contiguous().cpu()
  165             digest.update(data.json_bytes([str(tensor.dtype), list(tensor.shape)]))
  166             digest.update(tensor.reshape(-1).view(torch.uint8).numpy().tobytes())
  167         elif isinstance(item, dict):
  168             for key in sorted(item, key=str):
  169                 digest.update(data.json_bytes([str(type(key)), str(key)]))
  170                 visit(item[key])
  171         elif isinstance(item, (tuple, list)):
  172             digest.update(data.json_bytes(["sequence", len(item)]))
  173             for child in item:
  174                 visit(child)
  175         else:
  176             digest.update(data.json_bytes(item))
  177 
  178     visit(value)
  179     return digest.hexdigest()
  180 
  181 
  182 def save_state(path: Path, model: Any, optimizer: Any | None, metadata: dict) -> dict:
  183     import torch
  184     if path.exists():
  185         raise FileExistsError(path)
  186     payload = {"model": model.state_dict(), "metadata": metadata,
  187                "optimizer": optimizer.state_dict() if optimizer is not None else None}
  188     digest = state_digest(payload)
  189     torch.save(payload, path)
  190     return {"state_sha256": digest, **data.record(path, path.parent)}
  191 
  192 
  193 def restore_state(path: Path, model: Any, optimizer: Any | None, expected_digest: str) -> dict:
  194     import torch
  195     saved = torch.load(path, map_location="cpu", weights_only=True)
  196     if state_digest(saved) != expected_digest:
  197         raise ValueError("Saved model/optimizer state differs")
  198     model.load_state_dict(saved["model"], strict=True)
  199     if optimizer is not None:
  200         if saved["optimizer"] is None:
  201             raise ValueError("Missing required Adam state")
  202         optimizer.load_state_dict(saved["optimizer"])
  203     loaded = {"model": model.state_dict(), "metadata": saved["metadata"],
  204               "optimizer": optimizer.state_dict() if optimizer is not None else None}
  205     # Inference loads may deliberately omit saved Adam, but model bytes must match.
  206     if state_digest(loaded["model"]) != state_digest(saved["model"]):
  207         raise ValueError("Actual loaded model differs")
  208     if optimizer is not None and state_digest(loaded) != expected_digest:
  209         raise ValueError("Actual loaded Adam state differs")
  210     return saved["metadata"]

   33 def write_json(path: Path, value: Any) -> None:
   34     path.write_bytes(json_bytes(value))

   36 
   37 def sha256(path: Path) -> str:
   38     digest = hashlib.sha256()
   39     with path.open("rb") as stream:
   40         for block in iter(lambda: stream.read(4 * 1024 * 1024), b""):
   41             digest.update(block)
   42     return digest.hexdigest()
   43 
   44 
   45 def record(path: Path, base: Path) -> dict:
   46     return {"path": path.relative_to(base).as_posix(), "bytes": path.stat().st_size,
   47             "sha256": sha256(path)}
   48 
   49 
   50 def verify(path: Path, expected: dict) -> Path:
   51     if path.stat().st_size != expected["bytes"] or sha256(path) != expected["sha256"]:
   52         raise ValueError(f"File differs: {path.name}")
